build.prompt: FILE READING POLICY: When using the read tool for document, codebase, audit, review, analysis, or full-file tasks, do not use tiny read windows such as 30-40 lines unless a narrowly targeted lookup genuinely requires it. Request limit=2000 lines per read call whenever broad context or complete coverage is needed. If the output is truncated by a line or byte cap, immediately continue from the next offset and repeat until EOF. Never treat a partial read as a complete file. For large documents, systematically read all contiguous chunks required for full coverage before concluding. Small limits are allowed only for intentionally narrow follow-up reads.
